newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares start buoyant, seen testing 1,400.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares start buoyant, seen testing 1,400.

text.p: Austrian shares kick off week to firm start. Traders expect the index to make a fresh stab at 1,400 points given the firm futures market, dollar strength and friendly German leads.
*17 gainers outweigh three losers, with one unchanged
*Top gainer beverages group BBAG, up 2.45 percent at 795 ats.
*Top loser insurer Wiener Staedtische, down 2.55 pct at 1,071 ats
*July ATX future up 9.1 points at 1,406 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
